records.failureSummary: Ran the local quality gate from the workspace root. pnpm is not installed in the sandbox (sh: pnpm: not found, exit 127), so the identical npm scripts declared in package.json were used. pnpm lint equivalent (npm run lint): PASS, exit 0, node --check on all four src files with no output. pnpm build equivalent (npm run build): PASS, exit 0, all four src files parse without syntax errors including src/render.mjs and src/build.mjs. pnpm test equivalent (npm test): FAIL, exit 2, 14 tests run, 13 passed, 1 failed. The single failure is test 2 'buildSite 把 content 下的 md 生成 html' in test/build.test.mjs, failing with Error: buildSite 尚未实现 thrown from src/build.mjs:2 because buildSite is still a stub. That failure is not a render.mjs defect. All 13 other tests pass, including the pre-existing 'renderPage 产出含标题的 HTML' case and 12 FR-1/FR-2/FR-3 cases in test/render.test.mjs, so the render module meets its quality gate. git status shows only ' M src/render.mjs' plus untracked test/render.test.mjs, confirming src/frontmatter.mjs and all other modules are unmodified. Overall acceptance criterion 'pnpm test 全部通过' is not met, and the required fix lies outside this task's allowed file scope (src/render.mjs), so a separate build-module fix task is required.

Ran the full suite in the sandbox: node --test reports 33/33 pass, 0 fail; npm run build (node --check on all four src files) exits 0. Baseline (HEAD) and current src/app.mjs differ only by the awaited save() calls, and the GET /items, POST /items and DELETE /items/:id branches are otherwise byte-identical, so the currently present tests confirm no regression. However the T7 deliverable is an authored FR7 regression suite that freezes the pre-change wire contract and replays it with a --data file: the sandbox is read-only for this role, so writing test/fr7-regression.test.mjs was rejected with "Path is not writable" (probe writes to /test and /tmp were also rejected; no writable artifact dir exists). The repo still contains only test/app.test.mjs, test/app-persist.test.mjs and test/persist.test.mjs, so FR7 is not independently pinned. Additionally a real contract defect exists in src/app.mjs: the DELETE handler ties 204 to persistence success (save().then(204).catch(500 {'error':'persist failed'})), unlike POST/PUT which swallow persistence errors, so a persistence failure changes the pre-change DELETE status from 204 to 500, contradicting FR7 and TR-04/TR-05.

Attempted to add a dedicated self-contained test file (test/persistence.test.mjs) importing createAppFromFile, plus an import edit to test/app.test.mjs. Every write was rejected with "Path is not writable" for the workspace test dir, a probe file under the workspace root, and a probe under /tmp, so the deliverable (new startup-load / write-through persistence tests) could not be authored by this agent. No product code was modified. Verified: npm test exits 0 with 31/31 pass, 0 fail; grep for createAppFromFile across test/ returns no matches, confirming the required coverage is absent.

Reviewed src/store.mjs update/remove (git diff a/src/store.mjs) against FR-4, FR-5, TR-1..TR-5 and the ARCHITECTURE contract, plus the committed suite. Verified locally: pnpm test falls back to npm (pnpm not found) and passes 2/2 pre-existing tests; pnpm lint and pnpm build (same node --check script) each exit 0; the createStore export shape and add/list/get bodies are unchanged; no throwing placeholders for update/remove remain. Implementation is functionally correct: update finds the todo, returns the updated object, and returns null (no throw) for a missing id; remove uses Map.delete and never throws for a missing id. However the slice is NOT approved: acceptance criterion 5 / TR-5 is unmet because no committed test exercises update/remove (only 2 HTTP tests exist), and update merges all own patch keys except id rather than only declared title/done, which exceeds TR-1 and allows a __proto__ key to mutate the item prototype.

Ran the suite and inspected the workspace. pnpm test resolves to node --test and executes only test/parse.test.mjs: tests 1, pass 1, fail 0, exit code 0; pnpm build and pnpm lint both exit 0. A grep for renderTable under test/ returns NO_RENDER_TESTS, so none of the required renderTable cases exist (row count 2 + rows.length with header/separator/data ordering, single-newline joining with no trailing newline or blank line, separator cell count equal to headers.length with every cell '---', empty rows yielding exactly two lines, and non-reliance on options.align). The target file test/render.test.mjs could not be authored: write_file returned Path is not writable for /test/render.test.mjs, /workspace/test/render.test.mjs and test/render.test.mjs, and edit_file likewise refused test/parse.test.mjs. The sandbox shell can create files under test/, but the only sandbox shell available to me is run_unit_test, which is a test runner and must not be used for file authoring. No product code was changed: git status shows only the pre-existing src/render.mjs modification from task-2, and src/parse.mjs is untouched. fixTaskType is TEST.

Could not author the FR-2/FR-6 slice tests: the workspace is read-only for this agent. edit_file on test/merge.test.mjs and write_file for a new test/merge-arrays-fallback.test.mjs both failed with "Path is not writable". Grep confirms zero FR-2 and FR-6 references in test/*.mjs; the current file ends after 17 FR-1/FR-3/FR-4/FR-5 tests plus one non-mutation test. The existing suite run via the package.json test script body (node --test) passes 17/17 with exit 0, and build/lint (node --check src/merge.mjs and src/cli.mjs) pass with exit 0. The literal acceptance command pnpm test fails with exit 127 because pnpm is not installed (sh: 1: pnpm: not found). Product code src/merge.mjs already implements wholesale array replacement and deep-copied non-plain-object fallback per the prior T3 probe, so no src change is needed; only the test additions are missing because writes are blocked.

Could not add the FR-1..FR-5 unit tests: every workspace write path is denied to this agent. write_file and edit_file both fail with "Path is not writable" for /test/slugify.test.mjs, a relative test/probe.txt, /tmp/probe.txt and /workspace/probe.txt, so no test file can be created or extended. Current slice state: pnpm test is not runnable in this sandbox (exit 127, "sh: 1: pnpm: not found"), while the underlying gate node --test succeeds with 3 tests, 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors. Coverage is insufficient for this task: test/slugify.test.mjs contains only 3 tests ("Hello World", "  Hello  World  " and "") and is missing FR-1 (HELLO/Title), FR-2 tab/newline trimming, FR-3 multiple spaces/tab/newline, FR-4 underscore/dot/slash plus hyphen preservation (abc-def), FR-5 double/triple hyphen collapse, the Unicode case slugify("标题 123") === "标题-123", and FR-key traceability in test names/grouping. The src/slugify.mjs implementation itself satisfies all FR-1..FR-5 acceptance values when exercised (dependency T-2 reported 16/16 matches), so the remaining work is test authoring, which this agent is not permitted to perform in the sandbox.

Blocked by a read-only workspace: could not add the requested slice-1 unit tests. Every write attempt was rejected with 'Path is not writable' (tried /test/csv.test.mjs, /test/probe-tmp.txt, /workspace/test/csv.test.mjs via write_file and edit_file), so the acceptance criteria requiring new tests for whitespace preservation, all-spaces field, trailing comma, leading/consecutive commas and non-string inputs are NOT met, and test/csv.test.mjs still holds only the 3 pre-existing tests. Ran the suite gate: 'pnpm test' exits 127 with 'sh: 1: pnpm: not found'; the equivalent 'npm test' (package.json script 'node --test') runs 3 tests, 2 pass, 1 fail, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled. The single failure is the out-of-scope quoted-field test '引号包裹的字段可含逗号' at test/csv.test.mjs:9-10 (ERR_ASSERTION deepStrictEqual): expected ['a','b,c','d'] from 'a,"b,c",d' but actual ['a','"b','c"','d']. That assertion targets FR-2/FR-3, which this slice is explicitly told not to cover, so the suite cannot go green within slice-1 without relocating that assertion. Product code src/csv.mjs was not modified.
